## Plots & analysis (s) {.tabset .tabset-dropdown}

### Meta-ecosystems {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r}
metaecosystem_analysis = TRUE; patch_analysis = TRUE
heterotrophic_patches = FALSE
metaecosystem_type_i = c("small connected (s)",
                         "small unconnected (s)",
                         "small-medium connected (s)",
                         "small-medium unconnected (s)",
                         "medium-large connected (s)",
                         "medium-large unconnected (s)",
                         "large connected (s)",
                         "large unconnected (s)")

metaecosystem_type_input_analysis = metaecosystem_type_i
```

```{r child = here("r_files", "metaecosystems.Rmd")}
```

### heterotrophic patches {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r}
patch_analysis = FALSE; metaecosystem_analysis = TRUE
heterotrophic_patches = TRUE
patch_type_i = c("heterotrophic small unconnected (s)",
                 "heterotrophic small-medium unconnected (s)",
                 "heterotrophic medium-large unconnected (s)",
                 "heterotrophic large unconnected (s)",
                 "heterotrophic small connected (s)",
                 "heterotrophic small-medium connected (s)",
                 "heterotrophic medium-large connected (s)",
                 "heterotrophic large connected (s)")
patch_type_input_analysis = patch_type_i
```
